title: Dialogue 7 opening: On the Holy Spirit: God and from God by nature
english: Dialogue 7 — On the Holy Spirit: that he is God and from God by nature.
A turns from Son to Spirit. The Spirit is not a creature energy or impersonal force; he is God, from God, proper to the divine nature.
Hermias is shown texts where the Spirit searches, gives life, sanctifies, and is ranked with Father and Son in the baptismal name.
